notes: Downloads the complete 50-state-plus-DC school directory in separate resumable API slices. The authoritative provenance remains NCES CCD.
Current SEDA v6 school-level pooled cohort-standardized achievement file.
National EDFacts chronic-absence release with data notes.
Directory, institutional characteristics, completions by program, and dual-enrollment headcount.
Official CRDC 2021-22 public-use data archive, verified from the portal's Download Data Files table.
Official Census 2024 All Data Items workbook from the Annual Survey of School System Finances. This avoids the API key requirement while retaining district-level finance data.

Official 2022 NAEP mathematics report-table workbooks for grades 4 and 8, spanning national, state, and participating urban district results. These are the reproducible public benchmark extract; microdata remains subject to NCES data-use terms.

Official College Scorecard most-recent institution-level release, dated June 10, 2026. The release contains institutional characteristics, enrollment, aid, cost, completion, debt, repayment, and earnings measures.
Urban is an API distribution layer for sources already represented here. CCD is downloaded through its API; do not duplicate all mirrored source files.
Bounded API export used to verify ERIC metadata fields and retrieval. Future evidence discovery must record a topic-specific query and retrieval date.

Current NTPS public-use extracts are generated through NCES DataLab rather than a stable bulk-file URL. The downloaded official access and methods pages document the reproducible acquisition path and restrictions.

ECLS-K:2011 public-use child-level files and setup files are selected through NCES's data-products workflow. The captured official pages identify the available cohort, waves, documentation, and download path.
Public-use HSLS extracts are generated through NCES DataLab. The captured official access pages record the available waves, administrative records, and restricted-use boundary.

Official SSOCS data-products page links current 2021-22 public-use files and documentation. The captured pages preserve the reproducible download path while avoiding an unsupported claim that a specific school can be joined to public microdata.
Versioned bounded capture of the public review database landing page. Individual program reviews should be added as initiative-linked artifacts when cited.
Versioned public report-index capture. Public reports provide aggregate context; student-level outcomes require a separate arrangement.
Versioned official SLDS program and access capture. There is no national public SLDS download; state approval, documentation, and disclosure controls are mandatory for each future extract.

Bounded reproducible corpus of every WWC record cited by the dossier. WWC is continuously updated, so a dossier-specific corpus is preferable to an unsupported claim of a complete repository mirror. The tracked index maps each saved record to the source and initiative it supports.
